disposition_reason: Review paper: all heavy-metal values for bee and flower pollen (Tables 3 to 5 and text ranges such as lead in pollen 0,02 - 3,90 mg/kg) are quoted from earlier studies, including the authors' own earlier work, not new measurements.

study.design: Narrative review of nutritional and toxicological aspects of bee pollen
